description: Stations Velib à Issy-les-Moulineaux is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville d'Issy-les-Moulineaux. List and map of Velib stations, including real-time availability of bikes and terminals. Coverage: Ville d'Issy-les-Moulineaux. The portal shows the English title as "Velib stations in Issy-les-Moulineaux" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville d'Issy-les-Moulineaux. Its keywords include transport, temps-reel, mobilite, velos. The listing shows 2016-01-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
